criteria.description:

Inspect output/safeguards_gap_register.xlsx, output/legal_action_memo.docx, output/ftc_notice_draft.txt.
criteria.reasoning: LAW001 is satisfied. All three deliverables use actual eCFR citations (16 CFR Part 314: 314.2(m), 314.4(a)-(j), 314.5, 314.6 with subsections (c)(5), (d)(1), (d)(2), (e), (f)(1)-(3), (h), (i), (j)(1)(i)-(vi), (j)(2), (b)(1)) verified against the 2025-01-01 frozen XML — every cited subsection exists in that file (314.2(m) notification event at line 98, 314.4(c)(5) MFA at line 166, 314.4(j)(2) discovery attribution at line 204, 314.6 exceptions at line 218). The Sources sheet in safeguards_gap_register.xlsx explicitly marks eCFR_16_CFR_314_2025-01-01.xml as the '冻结适用版' (frozen applicable version). The current web page (ftc_safeguards_guide.html) is cited only for its eCFR link, not as the authoritative source. The 2021 XML is explicitly labeled '旧版对照' and noted as '不能用于本事件豁免判断' — used for comparison, not for governing exemptions. The legal_action_memo.docx builds an explicit evidence chain: 2021 final rule (controls + small-institution exception) → 2023 final rule (adds (j)) → 2024-05-13 effective date per 314.5 → 2025-01-01 frozen XML as the applicable version. Both the memo and the gap register consistently apply the 2025 frozen XML for every operative legal conclusion, satisfying the criterion.
